The '''Council of Meditation''' was a [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] in operation during the rule [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] and his [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. The Council of Meditation convened itself in the Order's secret [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] on [[Taivas]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].

==Overview==
The Council of Meditation was one of at least three [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councils]] functioning during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], a conflict fought between the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]]. Following the [[Massacre at Ossus|massacre]] of the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|academy]] of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and the takeover of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[New Jedi Temple|Temple]], the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] relocated to the planet [[Taivas]] where a [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|secret Temple]] had been established in the event of [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|another purge]].<ref name="LW1" />

Within the secret enclave the Council of Meditation was convened, made up of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] who communed with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] through [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] in hopes of divining its will. In [[138 ABY]], [[Cade Skywalker]] believed that Darth Krayt had survived an [[Battle on Had Abbadon|assassination attempt]] by his second in command [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]], and asserted this belief to the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]]. In turn the High Council consulted the Council of Meditation, questioning whether Darth Krayt had indeed survived to terrorize the galaxy. The members of the Council could not conclude that the Sith Lord had survived; though they vowed to continue to meditate on the question upon the request of Master [[Wolf Sazen]].<ref name="LW1" />
